'''Murachau''' was the language of the [[Murachaun]] species from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nahsu Minor]]. Murachauns read, wrote, and spoke their own language, which incorporated both words and gestures, but they were also able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Murachaun language was first mentioned in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GW" />
